detail: Full summary: The workflow script had a post-processing bug: results.filter(Boolean) before flatMap((r,i)=>DIMENSIONS[i]) mislabels dims when finders fail — the two confirmed findings labeled d2-lifecycle actually came from the d4-partition finder
